overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Las Vegas Aces on winning the 2025 Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) championship on October 10, 2025, their third title in four seasons. It highlights the team's comeback from a slow start, including a 16-game winning streak, its win in the league's first best-of-seven Finals, and individual achievements such as center A'ja Wilson winning the league MVP, Defensive Player of the Year, and Finals MVP awards in the same season. It recognizes all the players, coaches, and staff and asks that copies be sent to team leaders. It is ceremonial and does not change any law. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on December 8, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes a historic season for a Nevada team and the growth of women's professional sports.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
